Partner with others in the Legal team on privacy questions that arise in product design. Support Product and Engineering with customer, community and regulator questions about how our products meet legal requirements. Support complex technology and commercial deals (c. 20% of the role) Review, draft and negotiate technology-heavy agreements (SaaS and self-hosted), partnership and integration, and AI model and cloud provider contracts. jobs.title: Growth Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About viral.app viral.app is the software brands and agencies use to run UGC marketing at scale. It helps to hire creators, track every video on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and Snapchat, and pay creators based on performance. So far the founders have run marketing alongside everything else: SEO and content, free tools, our newsletter The FYP Leak, Google Ads, and posts on LinkedIn and X. Tracking and a lot of the scrappy growth work already run on AI automations we built ourselves. We're hiring a Growth Lead for the channels and content that don't automate well and need skill and taste. This is a hands-on role. You set the plan and do most of the work together with the founders. Your tasks Own growth end to end: the plan, the budget and the execution. Build a niche audience around creator marketing on LinkedIn and X under your own name. If you already have one, bring it. If you don't, you're motivated to build it from zero. Create the content formats that are hard to automate, for example short-form video, customer stories, founder-led posts and deep dives on what makes UGC perform. Test and run any channel that could bring us customers, for example LinkedIn, X, YouTube, cold email, Google Ads, Meta ads, organic content, AEO (getting cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews), Reddit, affiliate marketing and B2B creators. Spend most of your time on the channels where quality beats volume. For paid channels, run the ad accounts yourself: targeting, copy, creative briefs and budget. Run experiments every week. Measure them against signups, trials and revenue, and keep what works. Work with the founders and engineering on positioning, launches, onboarding and pricing pages. Bring in freelancers or agencies where they're faster, and help build a growth team as we grow. What success looks like after 90 days You've launched at least two content formats we couldn't have automated, and our audience shares them. You've found at least one organic and one paid channel that bring in signups week after week. You post on LinkedIn and X every week, and your audience in creator marketing is growing. Experiments ship every week, and each one ends with a written result. We have a growth plan for the next six months that you wrote and own. Your profile About 3 years in B2B SaaS growth or marketing, with results you can show in numbers: signups, pipeline or ARR. Fewer years are fine if your results stand out. You've grown a B2B SaaS product through organic channels such as SEO, content, community or product-led loops, and you did much of that work yourself. You've run paid acquisition for B2B SaaS from inside the ad accounts. You know what CAC and payback should look like for a self-serve plan compared with a sales-assisted deal. You've owned several channels at once, from first idea to live campaign to reporting. You move fast. You'd rather ship five small tests this week than one perfect campaign next quarter. You're scrappy. You write the landing page, build the campaign and pull the numbers yourself, and you know where AI saves time and where it hurts quality. You have taste. You can tell a post, video or landing page that will land from one that won't, and you can make the good one yourself. Fluent English. German is a plus. Nice to have An existing audience of marketers, founders or creators on LinkedIn or X Experience with creator, UGC or influencer marketing, or with selling to performance marketers and agencies Early-stage startup experience, ideally as the first marketing or growth hire You've used free tools or data reports as a growth channel What we offer You own growth and report directly to the CEO. €40,000–80,000 per year, depending on experience. Virtual stock options (VSOP) are possible for the right person. A budget for ads and tools. Fully remote from anywhere in a European time zone, with in-person team meetups several times a year. Short decision paths. If a test makes sense, you can run it the same week.

You inherit that and the mandate to shape what comes next. We are expanding fast into new verticals and geographies, and installation and service quality is one of the few things that can either unlock or throttle that growth. Be the escalation point that actually resolves things — including on site, out of hours, when a go-live is at risk. Own the operational KPIs and the commitments we make to customers, and keep Technical Customer Support, Business Development, and the executive team informed. Building the Operating System (≈ 35%) Raise SOP maturity — across our own team, our partners, and our customers’ contractors. Implement a continuous improvement engine together with the Operational Excellence team. Leverage and drive the tooling and data we need to run this at scale — field service management, installation and service documentation, spare parts and capacity planning — and make sure people actually use it. Build the quality and safety standards our engineers work to, and hold the line on them under schedule pressure. Leading and Scaling the Team (≈ 25%) Lead and develop the whole team — Field Engineers, Project Managers, and regional leads alike — building the depth and ownership that lets each region run well without you in the detail. Define and operationalize the Field Operations roadmap, and translate it into a capacity and hiring plan the business can commit to. Build the culture: high standards, low ego, no blame, and a bias toward fixing things properly. jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”. In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”. 85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz.  Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen. Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr. Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz.  Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”.  Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat. Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein. Technology never rests. Neither do we. ÜBER DEINEN JOB Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass Sicherheit ein technisches Thema ist. Deshalb glauben wir, dass nur ein echter Engineer für die Sicherheit bei freiheit.com verantwortlich sein kann. Nur wenn Du weißt, wie die Dinge funktionieren, kannst Du Prozesse und Richtlinien entwerfen, um uns und unsere Daten sicher und geschützt zu halten. Du entwirfst und implementierst die Infrastruktur, damit Du einfache, aber dennoch zuverlässige und sichere Prozesse sowie Richtlinien einführen kannst. Da Du von Herzen Engineer bist, schreibst Du Code, um manuelle Aufgaben zu automatisieren. Du weißt sowieso, dass es der einzige Weg ist. Du bist aber auch für unser ISMS (Information Security Management System) verantwortlich und sorgst dafür, dass dieses stets auf dem neuesten Stand ist und die Regeln und Vorschriften im ISMS sinnvoll und hilfreich sind. Ebenso arbeitest Du mit unserem Datenschutzbeauftragten zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir die DSGVO einhalten. Du stärkst unsere Mitglieder auch, indem Du ihnen Sicherheit beibringst. Sowohl durch die Gestaltung von Schulungen als auch durch die Unterstützung bei der Schaffung einer sicheren Infrastruktur in ihren Projekten. Das Jobprofil ist eine tolle Chance für Software Engineers, die ihr Spektrum in Richtung Sicherheit und Compliance erweitern und zudem strategisch arbeiten möchten. Wir glauben auch, dass eine kleine Dosis Zwangsstörung hilfreich sein könnte ;-). Zumindest solltest Du den starken Willen haben, die Dinge richtig zu machen, und sehr sorgfältig bei Deiner Arbeit sein. ÜBER DICH Qualifikationen: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik, Physik oder Elektrotechnik Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes Erfahrung in der UNIX-Systemadministration und Networking Programmiererfahrung – idealerweise in Go Hoher Einfluss auf den technischen Erfolg Deiner vergangenen Projekte Die Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch.  Bonus Skills and Interessen: Master oder Doktortitel in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik oder Physik Erfahrung in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS) oder Microsoft Azure Erfahrung mit Observability (Protokollierung, Überwachung, Alarmierung, Rückverfolgung) Erfahrung mit Security Erfahrung im Umgang mit verteilten Systemen in der Cloud (Terraform) Erfahrung im Einrichten von CI/CD-Pipelines ÜBER UNSERE COMMUNITY Auf die Frage, warum jemand hier arbeitet, laut

jobs.title: Account Executive DACH - SMB (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About Agicap   Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.   Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.   We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.   These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.   We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!   Home page Customer Stories Our Values About the Account Executive - SMB role: We are growing our team in Düsseldorf! Working closely with the Business Development team, Outbound SDRs, Inbound SDRs and Partnership Managers on a daily basis, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new clients. As an SMB Account Executive at Agicap, you will drive sales and expand our customer base within the SMB segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients and closing deals in order to achieve your sales targets. You will be responsible for: Defining and implementing a sectoral development strategy with your SDRs. Identifying and targeting SMB companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions. Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of Agicap’s offerings. Developing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, and referrals. Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations. Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets. Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends. Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement. Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product. Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance. What we are looking for: Native/Bilingual level of German 2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS. Studies background in a top business or Engineering school. A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets. A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results. Someone who can put themselves in the shoes of business leaders to understand their current and future cash flow needs. Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity. Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives. A strong business acumen and above-average interpersonal skills. A team spirit and a desire to share knowledge, helping colleagues grow. 7 Reasons to Join Agicap as an AE: Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round: Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC) Strongly differentiated solution, leader in Europe (G2)

jobs.description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. Our testing spans component, system and vehicle levels, and we build novel test automation in-house to identify issues earlier in development. We pride ourselves on finding the most efficient and effective ways to deliver the most valuable results for the company. As a System Test Engineer, HIL, you’ll build robust, reusable automation and work across engineering disciplines to improve coverage, reliability and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system, including sensing and model-behaviour testing, as Wayve and your experience evolve. 🧠 Your day-to-day Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration and system levels, working across software and hardware boundaries. Lead root-cause investigations for failures identified during test campaigns, collaborating with hardware, software, infrastructure and DevOps teams to resolve issues. Analyse test results, uncover software and hardware bugs, and report findings through Jira with clear evidence to support debugging. Optimise Buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable and repeatable execution. Review, create and follow risk assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Independently owning the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack, steadily raising the bar on coverage, reliability and traceability. Building open-loop and closed-loop hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) replay tests, alongside reliability and fault-injection tests, to support verification, release and debugging. Automating HIL test setups and improving test infrastructure to expand coverage, make failures easier to trace and strengthen compliance reporting. Integrating requirements, coverage and compliance workflows, including Jama, MC/DC coverage analysis and MISRA checks, and managing test artefacts through Artifactory and Azure. Developing traceability dashboards and defining KPIs and quality metrics that support data-driven validation and release decisions. 🙌 You should apply if: You have hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software or mechatronic systems, with a track record of independently delivering test automation. You’re highly proficient in Python and have experience developing automation test frameworks using pytest. You’ve worked with HIL testing and tooling, including interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet or GMSL, and tools from dSPACE, Vector, Xylon or similar providers. You understand open-loop and closed-loop HIL replay testing using dSPACE or other emulators. You’re familiar with automotive safety and process standards, including ISO 26262, ASPICE and SOTIF, and have experience integrating requirements and test-management tools such as Jama and Xray. You’re proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling, such as GitLab CI, Buildkite and Bazel. You have experience developing or testing automotive software at embedded and system levels, including hardware/software interactions and interface-level testing, and have worked with L2+ hands-off, L3 or L4 automated driving systems. You have knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols such as Euro NCAP, including AEB and LSS/LKA scenarios; DCAS regulatory testing under UN R171; and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards, including ISO/SAE 21434 and UN R155. jobs.title: Assistant Financial Controller
jobs.description: About Flock Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! About the role Reporting to Sarah Phillips, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it. It suits a recently qualified accountant with strong core accounting from practice, who has already improved a process or control somewhere and wants to keep growing within the finance team. What you’ll be doing Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time. Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and post journals, keeping the ledger clean and well evidenced. Run variance analysis and build the monthly MI pack, explaining what moved and why. Strengthen our financial controls and automate manual steps wherever you find them. Prepare our VAT returns and assist with group reporting. Work with FP&A so the numbers behind budgets and senior reporting are right. Support the annual audit and work alongside our external auditors. Use AI tools in your daily work to speed up reconciliations, analysis and reporting, and share what works with the team. Pick up ad hoc finance projects, including R&D tax claims if you have the experience. What you’ll need An ACA qualification, ideally recently qualified, although we’ll also consider strong ACCA or CIMA candidates. A practice background with hands-on month-end experience, whether from non-audit client work or time in industry. Big 4 or not makes no difference to us. Solid core accounting and close attention to detail, including balance sheet reconciliations, journals and variance analysis. Experience strengthening financial controls or improving a finance process, with an example you can talk us through. Curiosity and ambition, with the drive to push things forward and keep learning. An interest in AI. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should already be using it at work or in your own time and want to do more with it. Nice to have: Audit experience. Experience using NetSuite. Experience automating finance processes. Exposure to R&D tax claims. Experience in the tech sector. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale. You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation. You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go. You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes. You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together. In this role, you will:   Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes. Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure. Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.  Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact. Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures,

Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides. Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien. jobs.title: Design System Manager - Consultant.e
jobs.description: Mindset Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière . Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise. Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision , une stratégie claire , et une gouvernance solide . Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte. Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents, composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable. Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence. Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow sans friction . How we work together 🤝 Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes. Aligner Design et Engineering en continu : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production. Piloter l'alignement stratégique multi-équipes : s'assurer que Produit, Tech, Design et business partagent la même vision et roadmap du DS, intégrée au même niveau que les autres produits. Répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs et contributeurs : centraliser les demandes, prioriser les évolutions, et faciliter la contribution fluide de designers, développeurs et PMs. Fédérer autour d'une culture DS partagée : faire du DS un produit vivant et co-créé, en favorisant des échanges transparents et en embarquant les équipes dans sa vision long terme How we get work done 🚀 Définir et piloter la roadmap du DS : feuille de route alignée sur les priorités produit et business, avec des objectifs mesurables à court et long terme. Automatiser les workflows du DS au maximum : pipelines de tokens, synchronisation design to code en temps réel, scripts de génération de documentation, réduire au minimum les tâches manuelles et les risques de désynchronisation. Structurer le DS pour l'IA et le prototypage rapide : concevoir une architecture de composants et de tokens qui rende le DS exploitable par les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable...). Cela implique : nomenclature stricte,variantes bien définies, props documentées, et une logique de composants qui s'aligne avec les patterns du code. Garantir la cohérence design-code : mettre en place des outils de vérification automatique pour s'assurer que ce qui est designé est bien ce qui est développé sans avoir à le vérifier manuellement. Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques à grande échelle : formations, ateliers, documentation vivante pour que le DS soit utilisé de manière fluide et scalable par toutes les équipes. Mesurer l'impact et itérer : KPIs d'adoption, indicateurs de qualité, retours qualitatifs pour évaluer l'impact du DS et ajuster les priorités How our work creates impact 🎯   Accélérer le delivery produit : composants prêts à l'emploi, pipelines automatisés et prompts IA calibrés sur le DS. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: About Kestra Kestra is the universal orchestration platform : open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide , including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole , Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community. About the role Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise. You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem. This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one. What you would do Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows. Conduct hands-on penetration testing and threat modeling across our web application, APIs, control plane, and cloud environments. Manage end-to-end vulnerability tracking across our codebases, software dependencies (SCA), container images, and cloud infrastructure. Proactively fix security flaws by writing patches, submitting Pull Requests (PRs), or collaborating directly with product teams to guide remediation. Audit and harden our cloud infrastructure (GCP, Kubernetes clusters, and networking configurations) against external and internal threats. Automate security tooling into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, dependency scanners) to catch CVEs before code reaches production. Perform security code reviews and evaluate third-party dependencies, open-source integrations, and supply-chain risks. Lead incident response efforts and establish continuous monitoring, detection, and mitigation strategies. Own our public security posture as an open-source project: vulnerability disclosure process, CVE handling, security advisories, and the trust model of our plugin ecosystem. Our Tech Stack Security & Vulnerability Tools : Trivy, GitHub Security / Dependabot, Elastic Security Infrastructure : Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform Cloud : GCP Programming language : Java, Typescript, Javascript Datastore : PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch Queuing : Redis, Kafka, AMQP Monitoring & Logs : ELK, Prometheus, Grafana Deployment & Repository : GitHub Actions, ArgoCD What we are looking for 5+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Product Security, DevSecOps, or a combined Offensive/Defensive role. Strong hands-on penetration testing background , with proven ability to discover application, API, and network-level vulnerabilities. A builder/fixer mindset : You don't just export scanner PDFs; you can read code, understand exploits, write fixes, or provide clear remediation steps to engineers. Deep familiarity with cloud security (AWS or GCP) and containerized environments ( Kubernetes , Docker). Experience with dependency and supply-chain security (CVE management, open-source licensing, SCA tools). Fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote environment. Adaptability to a fast-paced open-source startup environment where pragmatism and execution speed matter. Perks & Benefits Work f

jobs.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. About the Role You'll be Vibe's founding security hire. Security has been part of how we build since day one and we're already SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, but nobody has owned it full-time. Ad spend and headcount have both roughly doubled every year since 2022, enterprise partnerships keep expanding, and the more visible Vibe becomes, the more scrutiny comes with it. Now it needs an owner. You'll define the risk model, set the roadmap, decide what we harden and what we accept, and turn policies into running procedures in code on the paths engineers and AI already use. That work happens in a cloud native ecosystem across AWS and GCP, with most of our services running on Kubernetes, everything as code and a GitOps deployment model. Reporting to our, Head of Infrastructure, and joining a lean six-person Infrastructure and IT team. You won't do it alone, but you'll be the main contributor, and the person every team turns to on security. Since we joined forces with Walmart, you'll also coordinate directly with their cloud security teams. What You'll Do Risk & Governance Map Vibe's risk model across every major system. Set the security roadmap with clear priorities. Security Engineering Pave the road with guardrails and secure defaults enforced across the engineering tool set. Ship the golden paths so the safe way is the easy one. Harden security across our cloud native ecosystem (AWS and GCP) and third-party providers. Own access management from onboarding to offboarding, and get it to the point where it runs without you. Detection & Response Prioritize vulnerability findings by real exposure, assign them to the team that owns the code, and follow remediation through to closure. Own security incident response from detection through resolution. Turn manual processes into pipelines that run on their own. Launch and run Vibe's private bug bounty program. Trust & Compliance Own SOC 2 compliance end to end and maintain current certification. Drive Vibe's future compliance initiatives and requirements. Define Vibe's security posture and make it self-serve so enterprise deals clear security without routing through you. Security Culture Set clear, practical rules for safe AI use, built into the tools themselves, covering both the AI we ship in our products and the AI our teams work with every day. Run security awareness training and measure behavior changes so the whole company raises its bar. What You Need Built a security function as a company's first security hire. jobs.title: Stage M2 : Recherche en optique non linéaire appliquée à la caractérisation de dispositifs électroniques neuromorphiques - 6 mois
jobs.description: Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique. L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle. Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an).   Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage : Des dispositifs d’électronique organique ultra-flexibles, conformables et implantables incorporant une intelligence artificielle promettent de révolutionner la surveillance et le traitement en temps réel de maladies chroniques [1]. De tels systèmes pourraient être basés sur des transistors organiques électrochimiques (OECTs), exploitant des conducteurs polymères mixtes ion-électron (PMIECs) comme couches actives. En effet, les PMIECs sont apparus comme une excellente plateforme matérielle pour interfacer la biologie avec l’électronique conventionnelle ; identifié comme le domaine de la « bioélectronique organique ou plastique ». L’OECT est considéré comme l’éléments clé pour réaliser une telle interface [2]. Son efficacité est évaluée suivant des figures de mérite (FoMs) telles que i) la transconductance (gm), et/ou ii) les temps de commutation (ionique vs. électronique) dans le dispositif. Au-delà des applications de transduction, à court terme, l’OECT est aussi intéressant pour créer des applications émergentes en matière de circuits neuromorphiques bioélectroniques [3]. La réalisation de tels circuits est freinée par un manque de compréhension et d’optimisation des processus de conduction mixte dans ces matériaux polymériques ; notamment une asymétrie des temps de commutation des transistors lors des séquences de dopage (i.e « ON ») vs dédopage (i.e « OFF ») dans le canal de l’OECT. Des outils de caractérisation in-situ & operando permettant de quantifier et cartographier les paramètres de transduction électronique et électrochimique dans le canal de l’OECT se révèlent être indispensables pour comprendre les limitations actuelles en performances des PMIECs et/ou pour construire des PMIECs optimums dans de tels circuits neuromorphiques.   Dans ce contexte scientifique, le.la stagiaire développera une nouvelle mesure de spectroscopie et instrumentation d’optique non linéaire, appelée microscopie par génération de second harmonique résolue en temps, afin d’enregistrer le mouvement spatio-temporel des espèces chargées, ion et électrons (ou trous), et ainsi donc cartographier les mobilités électroniques in-situ & operando le canal de l’OECT. La.le stagiaire fabriquera ces dispositifs OECTs en salle blanche de microélectronique, et bénéficiera d’un accompagnement technique pour leur réalisation. Il.elle enregistrera et analysera les FoMs clés grâce à l'expérimentation d’optique non linéaire développée et aux caractérisations électriques et électrochimiques afin d’établir, de manière plus globale, des règles d’ingénierie dans ces PMIECs qui serviront de socle de connaissances incontournables à l’avenir, pour mettre en œuvre et appliquer des circuits neuromorphiques à base d'OECTs, comme première brique d’une intelligence artificielle d’électronique organique.

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
tags: inl - institut des nanotechnologies de lyon
jobs.description: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains. A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program. In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems. The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations. Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated. Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics. jobs.title: Senior Projectmanager
jobs.description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. Wat bieden wij jou? Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Shop
jobs.description: ABOUT INSIFY We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets.  Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild. Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance. About the role You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers. The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people. Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows. As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together. You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth. What you'll be doing Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others What you'll need 3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt Strong fundamentals in domain-driven design & service oriented architecture Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you. Nice to have Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets Strong observability instincts. jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment

jobs.description: 24-40 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,- stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Waterbeheer heeft wonen, werken en leven in Nederland mogelijk gemaakt. Drinkwaterbedrijven luiden de noodklok over leveringszekerheid en piekbuien wisselen af met extreme droogte. Water is bepalend voor waar we kunnen bouwen, werken en leven. Om weerbaar te worden moeten we andere keuzes maken over de inrichting en het gebruik van onze leefomgeving, waarbij functies beter aansluiten op de draagkracht van het water- en bodemsysteem. Voor je onderzoek kun je ook putten uit andere lopende trajecten van ons team, zoals het Deltaprogramma Ruimtelijke Adaptatie (DPRA). Initiatief nemen: je werkt mee aan inhoudelijke kennissessies en netwerkevenementen om het watercluster van Berenschot op de kaart te zetten. Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. jobs.title: Stage consultancy in de Zorg, onderwijs en sociaal domein
jobs.description: 0,8 -1fte uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Zorg en maatschappelijke ontwikkeling| € 600,- Wo Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Wil jij je master-afstudeeronderzoek combineren met praktijkervaring bij een toonaangevend adviesbureau? En wil je bijdragen aan actuele ontwikkelingen in de zorg, het onderwijs of het sociaal domein? Lees dan verder. Voor onze adviesgroep Zorg en Maatschappelijke Ontwikkeling (ZMO) zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en gedreven stagiair voor de periode februari tot en met juni 2027. Je werkt drie dagen per week mee aan adviesopdrachten en besteedt de overige twee dagen aan je afstudeeronderzoek. Tijdens je stage werk je drie dagen samen met ervaren adviseurs en lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan lopende opdrachten. Zo maak je kennis met het adviesvak en ontwikkel je jouw onderzoeks- en adviesvaardigheden. Onze opdrachtgevers zijn onder meer ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, gemeenten, zorgaanbieders en onderwijsinstellingen. We helpen hen bij uiteenlopende vraagstukken zoals de organisatie en betaalbaarheid van zorg, de toekomst van het onderwijs en passende ondersteuning voor inwoners. De rode draad in onze opdrachten is dat ze maatschappelijk urgent en bestuurlijk complex zijn. Naast het meewerken aan adviesopdrachten is er ruimte om aan je scriptie te werken. Voor je afstudeeronderzoek draag je zelf een relevant onderwerp aan. Uiteraard denken wij graag met je mee om je onderzoek goed aan te laten sluiten bij onze praktijk, en hoe wij je bijvoorbeeld kunnen helpen met het werven van respondenten voor interviews, of het aanleveren van bestaande use-cases over jouw onderwerp. Dit ga je doen Je ondersteunt en werkt mee bij onderzoeks- en adviesopdrachten, bijvoorbeeld bij het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van interviews en werksessies, uitvoeren van kwalitatieve en kwantitatieve analyses, en het meeschrijven aan rapportages en artikelen. Je neemt deel aan teamoverleggen, kennissessies, trainingen en interne bijeenkomsten. Je ondersteunt bij congressen, conferenties en klantbijeenkomsten. Je sluit in overleg aan bij één van de drie teams binnen de afdeling ZMO: team zorg, onderwijs of sociaal domein. Afhankelijk van het team waarin je terecht komt, werk je mee aan thema’s zoals: Sociaal Domein: Je onderzoekt hoe organisaties de Participatiewet en de Wet sociale werkvoorziening (Wsw) toekomstbestendig kunnen uitvoeren. Je adviseert over de strategische koers van het asiel- en inburgeringsbeleid en evalueert hoe de uitvoering bijdraagt aan de beleidsdoelen. Je onderzoekt hoe gemeenten meer grip kunnen krijgen op de kosten van de jeugdzorg en begeleidt hen bij het doorvoeren van verbeteringen. Je ondersteunt gemeenten bij het inrichten en verbeteren van de toegang tot ondersteuning binnen het sociaal domein. Zorg: Je ondersteunt zorgorganisaties bij het versterken van hun weerbaarheid en het waarborgen van de zorgcontinuïteit, zodat noodzakelijke zorg bij verstoringen, zoals uitval van ICT of personeel, kan doorgaan. Je adviseert zorgorganisaties over de inzet van digitale toepassingen en ondersteunt hen bij het verbeteren van de gegevensuitwisseling tussen zorgverleners. Je werkt met bewoners, gemeenten en zorg- en welzijnsorganisaties aan zorgzame buurten, waarin mensen naar elkaar omzien en zorg en ondersteuning dichtbij beschikbaar zijn. Je ondersteunt zorgorganisaties bij bedrijfskundige opgaven, zoals het verbeteren van de bedrijfsvoering, het beheersen van kosten en het afstemmen van capaciteit op de zorgvraag. Onderwijs: Je onderzoekt hoe het onderwijsaanbod in po, vo, mbo en ho bereikbaar en toekomstbestendig kan blijven en adviseert over de spreiding van scholen en opleidingen. Je adviseert onderwijsregio’s en schoolbesturen over de aanpak van het lerarentekort en ondersteunt hen bij regionale samenwerking en het anders organiseren van onderwijs. Je onderzoekt hoe onderwijsinstellingen hun organisatie en middelen kunnen afstemmen op toekomstige opgaven en begeleidt hen bij organisatieverande

jobs.title: Medior/Senior R&D Engineer Interoperability in Battle Labs & Experimentation (m/v/x/)
jobs.description: Ben jij een specialist op het gebied van computernetwerken en protocollen en heb je affiniteit met het toepassen van simulatie- en trainingssystemen in een R&D context? Wil jij werken in een innovatieve onderzoeksomgeving waar geavanceerde simulatoren en interoperabiliteit centraal staan? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Wat ga je doen? Als netwerk-expert binnen onze afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor onderzoek en ontwikkeling gericht op netwerken en systemen die verschillende simulatoren en operationele systemen veilig en efficiënt met elkaar verbinden. Je werkt aan vraagstukken met betrekking tot netwerkarchitecturen, (simulatie)protocollen zoals DIS en HLA, netwerkbeveiliging en schaalbaarheid van complexe simulatieomgevingen. Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan het mogelijk maken van interoperabiliteit tussen simulatoren, operationele systemen en autonome platforms, en bent betrokken bij de (door)ontwikkeling van zowel bestaande als nieuwe simulatienetwerken. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met onder andere softwareontwikkelaars, domeinexperts en toekomstige eindgebruikers aan innovatieve oplossingen voor nationale en internationale stakeholders. Je bent hiervoor bereid om te reizen naar verschillende locaties, voornamelijk binnen Nederland. Wat breng je mee? Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten! Daarnaast: Heb je een afgeronde bachelor of master opleiding in ICT, Computer Science, Informatica, Informatiekunde, of vergelijkbaar; Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 5 jaar ervaring op het gebied van netwerktechnologie, TCP/UDP, netwerkprotocollen, routering, switching en netwerkbeveiliging; Beheers je meerdere programmeertalen zoals C, C++, C#, Java en ervaring in scripting om experimenteeromgevingen snel op te zetten of aan te passen; Heb je interesse in experimenteren, wargaming en simulatie in een R&D-context; Heb je ervaring met het ontwerpen en beheren van robuuste, schaalbare netwerkomgevingen; Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties; Werk je graag samen, durft je te experimenteren en kan je technische keuzes uitleggen aan niet-technische collega’s; Kan jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken. Nice to have: Ervaring met of interesse in simulatie- en interoperabiliteitsprotocollen (DIS/HLA/FOMs); Ervaring met het opzetten van tijdelijke of experimentele infrastructuren; Kennis van netwerkbeveiliging of VPN-oplossingen; Ervaring met monitoring- of observabilitytools; Interesse in nieuwe technologieën zoals autonome systemen, AI in simulatie of digitale twins. jobs.title: Bereichsleiter / Division Director (m/w/d) – Bezahlte Studie in Deutschland
jobs.description: <h2 style="text-align: center;">Bereichsleiter / Division Director (m/w/d) – Bezahlte Studie in Deutschland</h2> <h3><em>About Prolific</em></h3> <p>Prolific connects researchers and organisations with people from a wide range of professional backgrounds. More than 35,000 researchers and organisations use Prolific to collect high-quality human insights for research and product development.</p> <h3><em>The opportunity</em></h3> <p>We are recruiting professionals currently working as a <strong>Bereichsleiter / Division Director in Germany</strong> to participate in a paid online leadership research study.</p> <p>The study explores how managers at large organisations approach leadership, decision-making, organisational change, career development, and the growing use of AI in the workplace. Your professional experience will help researchers understand how these developments affect leaders and their teams.</p> <h3><em>What you'll be doing</em></h3> <ul> <li>Completing a short online survey in English</li> <li>Sharing your views on leadership, management, and workplace change</li> <li>Answering questions about your responsibilities and professional experience</li> <li>Providing information about the size and type of organisation where you work</li> <li>Giving honest, considered responses based on your own experience</li> </ul> <h3><em>Who we're looking for</em></h3> <p>You may be eligible if you:</p> <ul> <li>Currently live and work in Germany</li> <li>Currently work as a <strong>Bereichsleiter / Division Director</strong> or in a closely comparable senior role</li> <li>Lead a business division or major organisational area above department level</li> <li>Work for an organisation with <strong>at least 1,000 employees</strong></li> <li>Are comfortable completing an online survey in English</li> <li>Meet the requirements in the study's short pre-screening questionnaire</li> </ul> <p>Participants may be asked to verify their identity, location, professional background, or other eligibility information.</p> <h3><em>Why participate?</em></h3> <p>Your experience will contribute to research into how large organisations can better support managers and employees as leadership expectations and workplace technologies change.</p> <p><strong>This is a paid research opportunity, not an application for permanent employment.</strong></p> <p>If you already have a Prolific account, you do not need to register again. Please ensure your participant profile is complete and up to date.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Legal Engineer - Tax & Audit, Munich
jobs.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. What you’ll be doing Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a traditional box. It's part legal ops, part product specialist, part solutions architect, and part client whisperer. If you enjoy roles that stay static, this probably isn't it. Your mission is to help our clients, some of the most sophisticated tax and legal advisory teams in the world, get the absolute most out of our platform. We are hiring for two of our teams. Our DACH team is focussed on working with Tax & Audit teams across the DACH market and our Benelux team is focussed on Tax & Audit teams across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. Both are based out of our Munich office. Acting as a thought partner to tax partners, legal advisory leaders, and consulting teams - building trusted relationships, addressing tricky pain points, and identifying high-value opportunities for them to scale their use of Legora across service lines and jurisdictions. Working together with Go To Market and Customer Success in taking full ownership of client relationships - from running pilots with key practice areas, to onboarding new team members across tax, legal and consulting functions, and ultimately guiding firm-wide adoption across Big 4 and professional services firms. Be the voice of tax and legal advisory users inside Legora - sharing insights from tax structuring teams, regulatory advisory practices, and legal consulting functions that directly inform product development, roadmap priorities, and strategic direction. Delivering clear, confident product demos and training that bring the power of our platform to life - whether you're presenting to a tax partner, rolling out to a global advisory team, or training legal consulting professionals. Documenting best practices from leading professional services firms, contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, and help shape how we grow this function globally. Confidently helping tax and legal advisory teams navigate one of the biggest shifts in how professional services operate - from evaluating the ROI and competitive advantage of AI to clearly mapping how AI will impact different service lines, from tax compliance to regulatory advisory. What you bring You come from the world of tax and legal advisory; but you've never been content with how things have always been done. You may have trained at a Big 4 firm, working across tax structuring, legal advisory, or consulting. jobs.title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)
jobs.description: About AIOS AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025 : We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026 : Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028 : Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030 : Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035 : With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS Being a Web Designer at AIOS We’re building a world-class team. As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results. Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life. You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match. This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu , our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann , our CRO Lead. You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO ( Richie ). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends. This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :) Key responsibilities You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast. Strategic ownership : Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks. High-converting web design : Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time. Value propositions : Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land. Follow the scent : Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy. Figma to live : Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer. AI-powered design and build : Use A

jobs.title: Marketing- & Kommunikations-Manager:in (d/w/m)
jobs.description: Project Bay ist der erste CoWorking-Living Space mit direktem Meerzugang und neuer Hotspot für Innovation im Norden. Die Themen „Digitalisierung, Künstliche Intelligenz und neue Mobilitätslösungen“ werden hierbei mit regionaler Community, Work-Life-Balance und Natur pur verbunden. Wir bieten unseren Kunden Büro- und CoWorking-Flächen, Break-Out-Optionen sowie Fortbildungen, Freizeitangebote und Übernachtungen direkt am Meer auf Rügen. Des Weiteren verfügen wir über einen Accelerator "Founders Bay", um junge Startups mit Fokus auf Nachhaltigkeit zu unterstützen. Ab sofort sind wir auch im Aufbau des ersten MakerSpaces auf der Insel Rügen. Neben digitalen Lösungen ist es notwendig auch einen Ort für Hardware-Lösungen zu schaffen. Mit den Synergien unseres neuen Accelerators für nachhaltige Startups und den Kooperationen zu den Hochschulen, Kammern usw., möchten wir mit dem MakerSpace einen Ort für Handwerk, Selbstständige, Kreative und Startups schaffen.
