If you've built something before, start here The hardest part of a startup usually isn't the code. It's finding customers who really need what you build and getting them to change how they work. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day. What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you. About Scalera Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket. Shape what to build. Get it in front of customers fast, watch how they actually use it, and iterate. Own it in production. When something breaks at a customer, it's yours to understand and fix. Build with AI. jobs.title: Senior Fleet Manager
jobs.description: Ben jij een vooruitdenker die complexe data moeiteloos vertaalt naar glashelder advies? Neem jij van nature de regie, ben je sterk in stakeholdermanagement en heb je affiniteit met de dynamische wereld van Schiphol? Lees dan snel verder! Binnen Orion Fleet Management zijn we op zoek naar een proactieve Senior Fleet Manager met een specifieke focus op onze klant Schiphol en ons label AirportPartners. Waar een reguliere Fleet Manager sterk leunt op de dagelijkse operatie, sta jij als Senior Fleet Manager daarboven. Jij kijkt verder dan de waan van de dag, anticipeert op wat komen gaat en gebruikt keiharde data om onze klant op strategisch niveau te adviseren. Wat ga je doen? In de rol van Senior Fleet Manager ben jij de absolute eigenaar van de vlootbeschikbaarheid voor Schiphol. Omdat jij de operationele basis feilloos begrijpt en beheerst, kun jij de vertaalslag maken naar optimalisatie en strategisch partnership.  Jouw takenpakket als Senior Fleet Manager bestaat uit de volgende pijlers: Datagedreven Regie & Strategie: Proactieve advisering: Je wacht niet tot de klant belt met een probleem, maar je adviseert hen ongevraagd over rendementsverbetering en risicobeperking op basis van jouw data-analyses; Datagedreven regie: Je gebruikt voorspellende data om de vloot optimaal in te zetten en stilstand te minimaliseren. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in. jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: About the role At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams. What you'll do Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building; Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why; Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable; Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses; Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority; Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release; Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing; Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features. What you bring A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field; At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer; Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans; Experience with test automation and test frameworks; You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests; Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira. You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not; You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business. Nice to have Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code; You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support. jobs.title: Head of Compliance
jobs.description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one. You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. What You’ll Own Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures. Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite. Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients. Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity. Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments. File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR. Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board. Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest. Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters. Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution. Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale. Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes. Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections. Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast. Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools. Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues. Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators. A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder. Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania. Nice to Have Lithuanian language ability. An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT. Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions. Experience with clients across several EEA countries. CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification. This Role Is Not For People who only want to attend meetings. Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business. People who say no without offering a compliant way forward. People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions. Location This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week

jobs.title: Model Risk Officer
jobs.description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used. This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day. You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle. What you'll ship Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle. Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each. Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models. Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers. Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks. Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit. What you'll bring Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models. Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced. Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook. Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them. The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge. Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own ter

jobs.title: Director, Data Science & Engineering, Finance
jobs.description: Role Description This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of data science, data engineering, finance, and AI. As Director, Data Science & Data Engineering for Finance, you will lead a small, high-impact team that enables Finance to make better decisions through trusted data, robust analytical systems, applied modeling, and increasingly AI-powered capabilities. You will manage two direct reports: a data scientist and a data engineer. Together, the team supports the financial organization across recurring business operations, driver-model maintenance, knowledge coordination, analytical insights, and the development and operationalization of AI and machine-learning use cases. The role requires enough technical depth to guide both disciplines, while maintaining a clear focus on business outcomes, reliability, and team growth. You will partner closely with Finance leadership, Engineering, Data, Product, and other cross-functional stakeholders to establish priorities, improve the quality and accessibility of financial data, and shape a forward-looking roadmap. You will be expected to move the team beyond request-driven execution: identifying the highest-leverage opportunities, clarifying the problems worth solving, and creating the operating mechanisms needed to deliver durable impact. This is an opportunity to shape how Finance uses data and AI at a time when the underlying technologies, operating models, and expectations are changing quickly. The successful candidate will bring a growth mindset, a strong background in either data science or data engineering, and the ability to lead effectively across both disciplines. Responsibilities Manage and grow a multidisciplinary team: Lead, coach, and develop a data scientist and a data engineer, creating clear expectations, meaningful development plans, effective delegation, and a strong culture of ownership and continuous improvement. Set the team’s strategy and priorities: Translate Finance and company goals into a focused portfolio of work. Prioritize ruthlessly across strategic initiatives, recurring operational responsibilities, model maintenance, knowledge coordination, and technical debt. Provide technical leadership across data science and data engineering: Guide problem framing, analytical and modeling approaches, data architecture, pipeline quality, testing, monitoring, documentation, and production readiness. You do not need to be the deepest expert in both disciplines, but you must be able to ask the right questions, recognize trade-offs, and raise the technical bar. Advance AI and modeling capabilities: Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI, machine learning, automation, and advanced analytics to Finance workflows. Establish appropriate standards for experimentation, evaluation, interpretability, human oversight, privacy, and ongoing monitoring. Build trusted data foundations: Partner with data engineering and Finance stakeholders to improve source-of-truth datasets, data quality, lineage, observability, documentation, and reliability. Ensure that recurring reporting, driver models, and downstream analyses are based on accurate and well-governed data. Create scalable operating mechanisms: Establish lightweight processes for intake, prioritization, roadmap planning, model and pipeline reviews, incident response, documentation, knowledge sharing, and stakeholder communication. Reduce dependency on individual heroics and make the team’s work easier to understand and extend. Influence Finance and senior stakeholders: Communicate complex data, model, and engineering considerations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Pre

This role is modeled on a classical Enterprise Architect role and adapted for an AI-first world. You will set the target-state architecture, choose the patterns we standardize on, write code yourself, and own the result. You will partner with our embedded business analysts and the leaders of each functional vertical so the platform stays grounded in real use cases, not abstractions. This is a player-coach role. You start hands-on. Over time you build and lead a small platform team. What You Will Build A centralized data lake on AWS: the single, governed source of truth for internal Banyan data. Set the patterns for storage, cataloging, query, ingestion, modeling, and lineage. Likely stack: S3, Glue, Lake Formation, Athena, Redshift, Iceberg or similar open table formats, plus Terraform or CDK for infrastructure as code. Stand up the AI experimentation layer: model access via Anthropic, OpenAI and other LLM Establish data contracts, schema standards, naming conventions, and a domain model that holds up as we add sources and acquire companies. Partner with our Senior Business Analysts embedded in Finance, M&A, and Business Development to translate use cases into platform requirements and to unblock their work. Define security, privacy, and AI safety guardrails. Classify data, design access tiering, and set the rules for handling PII, regulated data, and confidential portfolio information. Stay hands-on. Find suitable contractors for data platform engineers, ML platform engineers, and data engineers. Mentor them. Set the bar for engineering quality. Own platform reliability, observability, and cost. Set SLOs, monitor usage, and keep the bill rational as we scale. Represent Banyan's AI and data architecture to our executive team, our portfolio companies, and external partners. At least two functional verticals onboarded to the platform with safe,

Graph Integration Own pipelines integrating the graph database with the warehouse, lake, and primary databases, working within canonical data models and a single write path. Partner with data science to migrate legacy direct-to-graph services onto that shared path, and to evolve relational structures into graph-native models. GenAI/NLP Enablement Support and extend production genAI workflows — embeddings/similarity search, LLM-based extraction and classification — and keep our data infrastructure "AI-ready." Experience with open table formats and medallion lake architectures (e.g., Apache Iceberg) and distributed SQL engines (e.g., Trino, Presto). Experience with streaming/CDC pipelines (e.g., Kafka or Pulsar, Debezium, Flink or similar). Strong Python skills for pipelines, automation, and operational tooling. Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale. jobs.description: About impact.com impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results. Your Role at impact.com: Impact.com powers the partnership economy, helping brands and partners grow revenue through a modern SaaS platform used by thousands of companies globally. We're investing heavily in our growth, and this role sits at the centre of how data powers our go-to-market strategy and sales enablement. We're looking for an Analytics Manager to scale our marketing function. This is a senior individual contributor role - we need someone who’s comfortable owning a domain of the marketing analytics portfolio with light oversight. As Marketing Analytics Manager, you'll own the quality, consistency, and strategic impact of the core reporting used by our GTM teams to shape and prioritize multimillion dollar investment decisions. You'll work on a modern cloud stack (BigQuery, dbt, Looker) with strong support from Marketing and Sales teams - who will be your chief internal customers, and Analytics Engineering, who own the data platform and semantic layer you work with and on. What You'll Do: Own the process for the weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews that marketing and sales leaders use to track campaign performance and business trends — and improve them over time so they drive decisions rather than descriptions. Translate vague business questions ("why is pipeline soft in EMEA?") into workable analyses, sell a solution, and manage the delivery process efficiently. Partner with internal customers and engineers to move recurring manual reporting into useful tools that drive decisions which save time and money. Work directly with stakeholders across marketing, sales, finance, product, and customer success to scope what they actually need and design a plan to get them that information efficiently and with the right level of accuracy. Contribute to data collection and modeling conversations where marketing's needs intersect with the broader company data model. What You Bring: 5+ years of business analytics experience in a software or information business. A strong understanding of SQL and working proficiency with Python — enough to do your own analysis end-to-end without needing outside help. A track record of designing dashboards and reports that people use to actually make decisions, and a sense of taste on what makes the difference between decisive reporting and vague reporting. Ability to explain an analysis or technical concept to colleagues in a way that drives action. Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end with light oversight: you'll get direction on weekly priorities and outcomes, but will be trusted to set your own week and say no to the right things. Nice to Have: Experience with attribution modeling — multi-touch, time decay, incrementality Experience with lead scoring Experience with integration of sales and marketing data and a full-funnel perspective Experience with dbt, databricks, Looker, or another data management tool Experience in partnership marketing, digital marketing, or performance marketing Salary Range: $80,000 - $100,000 per year, plus an additional 5% vari

jobs.description: About the Role We’re building high-quality ground-truth datasets used to train and validate perception models for autonomous and operator-assisted machines working in complex, real-world environments. As a Data Annotation Analyst, you’ll work with camera imagery, video, and LiDAR point clouds to create precise labels that help perception systems understand objects, people, terrain, and surrounding environments. You’ll work in specialized annotation tools, following detailed specifications while balancing accuracy, consistency, and production volume. Your Impact Annotate 2D and 3D objects across images, video, and LiDAR point clouds, including vehicles, machinery, people, signage, and environmental features. Create and maintain accurate segmentation, object tracking, pose, and keypoint annotations across sequences. Apply detailed annotation guidelines, including class definitions, occlusion rules, object thresholds, and inclusion/exclusion criteria. Review your work, respond to QA feedback, and maintain established quality and accuracy standards. Identify and escalate ambiguous scenes, sensor artifacts, tooling issues, and gaps in specifications rather than making assumptions. Document data quality and tooling issues with clear details and reproduction steps. Participate in calibration sessions, guideline reviews, and team standups to maintain consistent interpretations. Share observations that help improve annotation guidelines, taxonomies, and edge-case documentation. Success in this role means producing accurate, consistent annotations at the expected volume while helping maintain a reliable, high-quality dataset. What You Bring Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while performing repetitive, visually intensive work for extended periods. Strong spatial reasoning skills, including the ability to interpret 3D environments and understand object size, position, and orientation. Ability to learn and navigate complex, purpose-built software and become productive with keyboard shortcuts and other tooling features. Experience working in a fast-paced, scaled environment with defined productivity, quality, or accuracy targets. Experience with image annotation GenAI workflows Reliable high-speed internet, a distraction-free workspace, and the ability to work on a company-provisioned machine within a controlled environment. Nice to Haves Associate or bachelor’s degree. Experience with image, video, LiDAR, or 3D annotation tools. Experience with subsurface utility engineering (SUE), construction surveying, surveying, GIS, or other work involving spatial interpretation of physical environments. Experience with AutoCAD or similar type tools Experience in construction, mining, agriculture, industrial operations, or heavy equipment environments. Familiarity with point cloud data, sensor fusion, or camera-LiDAR calibration. Experience working with autonomous vehicles, robotics, or machine perception datasets. Compensation Additional Information Why You’ll Love Working Here At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest-quality AI solutions for frontier models. You’ll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You’ll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time. About Appen Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre-training, supervised fine tuning

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: About Solace Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes. We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly. Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way. Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here . About the Role At Solace, data isn't just about understanding the past; it's about predicting the future. We are a rapidly scaling startup where we work hard, move fast, and wear many hats. The Solace Data Team is looking for a Data Scientist who excels at forecasting, prediction, and machine learning to help us anticipate patient needs and optimize our operations. Reporting directly to the VP of Data, you will have the opportunity to lead high-impact projects that directly influence our strategic decision-making. In this role, you will go beyond descriptive analytics to build the predictive engines that drive our business. Whether you are forecasting operational volume, modeling patient risk, or designing rigorous A/B tests, you will bridge the gap between advanced statistics and practical business application, ensuring our models are robust, interpretable, and impactful. What You’ll Do Build Predictive Models: Develop and refine machine learning models to solve critical business problems, such as predicting patient churn, estimating operational volume, or scoring advocate quality. Drive Forecasting Rigor: Own the development of time-series forecasts that guide our capacity planning and resource allocation. You will help us anticipate "what comes next" with higher accuracy. Design & Analyze Experiments: Lead the design and analysis of A/B tests and causal inference studies. You will ensure we measure the true impact of our product and operational changes. Uncover Deep Insights: Apply advanced statistical methods to complex datasets to find patterns that simple reporting might miss. You will answer the "why" and "how" behind our most difficult questions. Productionize Solutions: Work closely with Data Engineers to take your models from a local notebook to a production environment, ensuring they run reliably within our data infrastructure. Communicate Complexity: Translate complex statistical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders. You will be the voice of statistical reason in strategic discussions. What You Bring Statistical Expertise: You have a strong background in statistics, probability, and mathematics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time-series forecasting). Python & ML Proficiency: You are fluent in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, NumPy). You write clean, reproducible code. Forecasting Experience: You have hands-on experience with time-series analysis and forecasting techniques (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing). Advanced SQL: You can write complex queries to wrangle your own data from Snowflake without relying solely on others to prepare it for you. Preferred Masters Degree or PHD: Data Science, Applied Science, or related fields. Data Privacy Awareness: You understand the importance of protecting patient data. You are familiar with best practices for handling PHI and PII and ensuring privacy in your analysis. Startup DNA: You are a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity. You take ownership of problem

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us. At Dscout, we're building the human-grounded layer that teaches AI to work in the real world and proves it stays aligned there. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us. Dscout AI Training & Evals builds human data and evals that show whether AI works for real people. For ten years Dscout has captured how people behave in real context, with consent and scientific rigor. Dscout AI Training & Evals points that engine at AI: consented human behavior and judgment, turned into the training data, evals, and benchmarks AI teams trust. Models ace benchmarks and still surprise people in the wild. A benchmark says how capable a model is. It does not say whether the model works for the person using it, across weeks, in the mess of real life. That gap is where we work. We serve AI researchers, the product builders who ship alongside them, and the research teams who partner with both. We are a new unit inside an established company: live customers, a mature platform (React, Elixir, Python, Swift, Kotlin; SOC 2 and HITRUST certified), a small senior team, and room to build. We work AI-native. Agents write code, evals gate changes, and we aim to do in months what used to take years. A note from our Chief AI Officer & GM. The hardest AI problems show up when a model meets real people, with their tools, their interruptions, and their goals. Our customers need a partner who can design the answer, build it, and ship it fast. Ground Truth sits where deployment meets research: what we learn in the field shapes the science, and the science shapes what we ship. Come build it with us. Why this seat Work on a problem the field has not solved: measuring whether AI works for real people, over real time. Study something most evals do not have: real participants, doing real tasks in their own context. Own the benchmark. You are founding it, not joining a team that has one. Publish. Methods and benchmarks go to the research community, with first authorship on the benchmark. Join a small senior team with direct access to the Head of AI Research and the GM. This is a research-first role focused on questions where the right rubric, benchmark, or method does not yet exist. You will find the gaps, propose bold directions, and take projects from the first hypothesis through experiments and benchmark construction to publication. You will also build: the science has to run inside live customer programs. What you will do Rubrics and QA science Design rubrics and test whether they measure what they claim: validity, reliability, and sensitivity. Measure how reliable human raters are, and when disagreement is noise versus real signal. Calibrate AI judges against real human judgment, and study when they drift away from it. Build quality signals that put evidence behind every data point we ship. Long-horizon, real-user benchmarks Design Dscout’s first benchmark: real users, in real context, over long horizons. Multi-week tasks across tools, not one-shot prompts. Define the protocol, task design, scoring, and release. Work with our delivery team on fieldwork. Work out how to keep a living benchmark honest over time: drift, contamination, difficulty, and what counts as a meaningful change. Write the paper and own the public release. Human judgment as training and eval signal Study when real-world human feedback improves a model and when it adds noise. Explore how preference and judgment data from representative people differ

jobs.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role We are looking for a Lead Engineer, AI Agent Voice Experience to help build the next generation of AI-powered voice systems for the contact center. In this role, you will work at the intersection of speech, language, and real-time production systems, improving how AI listens, understands, reasons, empathizes, and responds in live customer conversations. You will develop and improve machine learning systems that power voice experiences end to end, including automatic speech recognition, turn detection, agentic workflows, voice evaluation, text to speech, speech-to-speech models, and production optimization. You will partner closely with applied researchers, product managers, designers, forward deployed engineers, and platform engineers to ensure model and system improvements translate into measurable customer and business impact. This role is ideal for someone who is excited by both model quality and production reality: designing rigorous evaluation frameworks, analyzing failure modes, improving latency and robustness, elevating caller interaction experience, and shipping systems that perform reliably at scale in real-time voice environments. Responsibilities Design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning systems that power real-time voice experiences, including speech to text turn detection, text to speech, speech to speech, reasoning and structured insight generation. Improve the quality of voice AI systems through error analysis, data curation, metric design, benchmarking, and iterative model improvement, with a strong focus on real-world performance. Build evaluation frameworks for complex voice and agentic systems, measuring metrics such as accuracy, robustness, latency, faithfulness, naturalness, professionalism, task completion, and cost. Diagnose and mitigate failure modes across the voice stack, including transcription errors, hallucinations, tool misuse, prompt brittleness, context drift, and multi-step reasoning breakdowns. Design, implement, and optimize low-latency ML systems that deliver delightful caller experience (e.g., backchanneling, focusing on foreground speaker, interpreting caller’s emotions, responding with empathy). Partner with platform and backend engineers to productionize real-time inference, streaming pipelines, quality monitoring, and continuous model iteration. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, frontend, and backend teams to integrate voice intelligence seamlessly into Cresta’s platform. Mentor engineers, contribute to technical strategy, and help shape the roadmap for Cresta’s voice AI systems. Qualifications we value Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field; Master’s or Ph.D. preferred. 5+ years of experience building, evaluating, and deploying machine learning systems in production. jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Researcher (Agentic Search)
jobs.description: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems. You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines. We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7. This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production. In the first year, you will own a specific part of the search stack, e.g. ranking or iterative retrieval. What you'll work on: Designing an agent-native search system that handles everything from low-latency single-hop search to complex deep search tasks requiring iterative planning, querying, refinement and reasoning. Training ranking and retrieval models optimized for agent-driven workflows under real world constraints Bringing the latest advances from the research community to our search stack and ship it to production. Your responsibilities: Drive applied research and technical direction across retrieval and ranking systems Design and evolve multi-stage retrieval architectures (query understanding, rewriting, retrieval, reranking and iterative retrieval) Lead experimentation on modern retrieval approaches (embedding research, sparse and hybrid retrieval, reranking, context compression) and bring them into production Develop methods for grounding LLMs in real-time web data at scale, using trust, quality and freshness signals to surface reliable sources Partner with the evaluation team to define new metrics for agentic systems, where correctness is not reducible to clicks Analyze trade-offs across relevance, latency, and cost, and work closely with engineering to deploy systems that operate at web scale Mentor researchers and engineers and help raise the technical bar of the team Must haves: 8+ years of experience in applied AI, ML, or software engineering Proven track record of shipping ML or AI systems to production at scale Deep experience with search, retrieval, ranking or building RAG-based assistants Strong understanding of modern deep learning, especially transformers and embeddings Experience with LLM-integrated or knowledge-intensive systems Experience designing evaluation frameworks and metrics for ML systems Strong programming skills in Python Top-tier publications (ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, AAAI, EMNLP, ACL) Ability to operate in a fast-moving, product-driven environment with high ownership and autonomy Nice to haves Background in agentic AI systems (agents, tool use, autonomous workflows) Experience

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
jobs.description: Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems. A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality. Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on. You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies. You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines. Key Responsibilities Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness. Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions. Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards. Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues. Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required. Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews. Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. Qualification path Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring. Basic Requirements Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English. Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years. Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills. Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools. Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer. Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently. High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets Preferred Qualifications Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification. Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems. Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering. Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements. Equal Opportunity All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.
